question: A rape survivor presents to the emergency department without a police referral letter. The doctor is legally permitted to delay the medical examination until a police First Information Report (FIR) is produced.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. Waiting for an FIR before examining a rape survivor is illegal. BNSS 2023 Section 184 mandates that hospitals must provide free immediate treatment and examination. Refusal or conditional treatment is an offence under the Act.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. BNSS 2023 Section 184 imposes a mandatory duty to examine and provide medical treatment regardless of whether a police referral or FIR has been produced. Delaying or refusing examination constitutes a legal offence. Medical care and evidence collection must not be conditional on police documentation.
